title: Map a commit to its objects
prompt:
In a repository with one commit, report the type of HEAD and inspect its tree reference without directly editing .git files.

Submission: a concise Markdown evidence report containing the commands run, key output, expected-versus-actual result, safety trade-offs, and any unresolved assumptions. Perform state-changing work only in a disposable repository or repository you are authorized to use.
target_skills: Git command selection and repository-state reasoning

expected_output: A reviewable evidence report showing the relevant Git commands, observed repository state, correct interpretation, validation steps and safety limits. No production changes or unverified claims are assumed.
acceptance_criteria: Include evidence for git cat-file -t HEAD.
Include evidence for git ls-tree HEAD.
State the repository/version assumptions and distinguish observed output from expectation.
Describe security or collaboration impact where relevant.
Do not report unrun tests or claim a successful remote/deployment operation without evidence.
hints: Start with the corresponding lesson and official references in references/reference-index.json.
Use a disposable repository and run read-only inspection commands before changing state.
Capture the exact output and explain its limitations; do not invent results.
grading_method: Static required-string smoke check plus human review of command correctness, evidence quality, repository safety and reproducibility. This exercise does not execute arbitrary learner code or make remote repository changes.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted after feedback; exercise completion and the platform-wide base XP are managed by the backend. No exercise XP override is authored.
